pose: Full side profile of a charismatic animated Suchomimus tenerensis (spinosaurid). MUST show: (1) long narrow crocodile-like snout with conical teeth, (2) a clear low-to-medium neural sail/ridge of elongated spines along the back — NOT a flat T. rex back, (3) longer three-fingered forelimbs than a tyrannosaur. Large expressive eyes and a slight confident smirk. Warm tan/orange body with darker striping. Entire body including neck and tail held in a perfectly horizontal line parallel to the ground. 28% empty space above the sail and below the feet for 17:7 crop safety. Not a tyrannosaur, not an allosaur, not Spinosaurus (sail is lower/longer than Spinosaurus).

framing_presets.WIDE_WEIGHT_STRIP_V2: Extreme wide shot. Character is a small silhouette in the vertical center. Clear sky or shallow-water habitat background. Massive negative space buffers.
